units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:4">Pes. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 48b:9">48ᵇ</cite>) <he>תפח תִּלְטוֹשׁ בצונן</he> (Y. ed. <he>בצונין</he>) if the dough shows evidence of rising, let her polish it by means of cold water (slap the dough with hands dipped in cold water); Y. ib. 30ᵇ top.
